name: SET domain containing 5

function.text: SETD5 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETD5. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and histone H3K36 methyltransferase activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of chromatin organization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); intellectual disability-facial dysmorphism syndrome due to SETD5 haploinsufficiency (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
